contexts.text: Celestial and spiritual food was signified by the sanctified things which they ate... The sanctified things were [the parts of] the sacrifices which were not burned upon the altar, and were eaten either by the priests, or by the people who made the offering. Illustrated.
That He should sanctify Himself to the Divine. Signified, Explained.
Their sanctifications were made by (burnt-offerings and sacrifices).
The Lord sanctified Himself to the Divine; that is, united the Human to the Divine, through the combats and victories of temptations. AC 2788.
The beginning of [His] sanctification. Signified, Explained.
The sanctification and adoption of (the spiritual). Signified, Explained.
To be purified, or cleansed, = to be sanctified. (Explained.)
By such things no one is sanctified.

That they were sanctified by external things... and that they were not sanctified by charity and faith; thus that they were holy, although they lived in hatreds, etc. (an example of the evil of falsity).
Sanctify to Me all the first-born () = that faith is from the Lord. To sanctify to the Lord = to ascribe to Him; that is, to confess and acknowledge that it is from Him.
By sanctification they began to understand sacrification. Explained.
Sanctify them today and tomorrow () = the veiling over of the interiors so that they may appear in the Holy of faith... AC 8806. AC 8832. AC 8838.
To sanctify (the Sabbath) () = no violation in any way.
And hallowed it () = that (the heavenly marriage with a regenerated man) cannot be violated.

I sanctify myself, that they also may be sanctified in the Truth () = that He made Himself Divine by His own power: those who receive in faith and life the Divine truth which proceeds from Him, are said to be sanctified in the Truth.
The sanctifications with (that) people were in order that the Lord who alone is holy might be represented, and in order that the Holy which is from Him alone might be represented. Illustrated.
I will be sanctified in them that are nigh to Me () = with those who have been conjoined with the Lord through the good of love and the truth of faith from the Word.

To sanctify him () = thus a representative of the Divine truth in (the Spiritual) Kingdom. To be sanctified = to be imbued with the Divine truth; for the Divine truth which proceeds from the Lord is what is called holy...
(Thus) it is the Lord who sanctifies man, Spirit, and Angel...

Thou shalt sanctify them () = thus a representative of the Lord as to the Divine Human. To sanctify = to represent the Holy itself which is the Lord as to the Divine Human; for this is what alone is holy... AC 9956:2, Illustrated. AC 9988.
All sanctification represents the Lord. AC 10098:end.
To sanctify = to represent the Lord, and the holy things which are from Him. AC 10111. AC 10126.
To sanctify it () = thus the Lord there. Explained.
Thou shalt sanctify it () = to receive the Lord. Explained.
It shall be sanctified in My glory () = what is receptive of the Divine truth from the Lord. (Explained.)
I will sanctify the tent of the assembly () = what is receptive of the Lord in the lower Heavens. (Explained.)

Thou shalt sanctify them, and they shall be the holies of holies () = thus the influx and presence of the Lord in the worship of the representative Church. To be sanctified = to represent the Lord as to the Divine Human, and the reception of the Divine good and Divine truth which are from Him. Explained.
To be sanctified = the influx and presence of the Lord...
To know that I Jehovah sanctify you () = the Lord as to the Divine Human, which all things of Heaven and the Church regard as their only source. Explained.
Sanctification is the reception of the Divine of the Lord. References.
The dogma that justification is real sanctification...
Hallowed be Thy name = to approach the Lord, and worship Him. Illustrated.
See Holy Spirit.
Through Divine truth from good; that is, through faith from charity, man is... sanctified, etc...
That the Lord sanctifies, etc. those who believe in Him...
Remember the Sabbath day, that thou sanctify it. General article. (See Sabbath.)
It is said that... sanctification follows this faith of itself...
Sanctification = the Divine proceeding; for Divine good is what sanctifies; and Divine truth is that which is derivatively holy.
To sanctify Himself = to make His Human Divine.
